label: The nine suffice for the field, from the Dei Filius restatement
description: A being with the nine has every typed Dei Filius attribute by the restated sufficiency, and so the primitive field by the field interpretation. This gives STMT-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-SUFFICE its first derivation, but it relocates rather than discharges the warrant: part of it moves into the field interpretation, a stipulation about an undefined primitive. On the full-list reading of the field (CLASSICAL_FIELD_2) the warrant gap becomes the field interpretation plus the seven bridges of nineGiveDeiFilius (with three existing premises). On the nine-reading (CLASSICAL_FIELD_1, the one Root.lean documents) the old premise is close to analytic and the bridges do no work for it. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
